sentences.text:

Hon'ble Sudhir Agarwal,J.
1.
None appeared to press this revision.
In the circumstances, I myself have perused the record.
2. This criminal revision under Section 397/401 Cr.P.C., has been filed aggrieved by judgement and order dated 27.11.1996.

The IIIrd Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Pilibhit vide judgement and order dated 11.11.1992 passed in Criminal Case No. 2088 of 1990, convicting revisionist under Section 7/16(1)(a)(c)(ii) of Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954 (hereinafter referred to as "Act, 1954") and sentencing to undergo three months rigorous imprisonment with fine of Rs. 500/-
under Section 16(1)(a)(ii) of Act, 1954 and in case of non payment of fine, he shall further suffer one month simple imprisonment and one year rigorous imprisonment under Section 16(1)(c) of Act,
1954 with fine of Rs. 1000/- and in case of non payment of fine, he shall further suffer three months simple imprisonment.

entities.text: IIIrd Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Pilibhit
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: , accused preferred Criminal Appeal No. 51 of 1992 which has been rejected by Appellate Court vide impugned judgement and order dated 27.11.1996 and confirming the sentence awarded by Court below.
Being aggrieved, revisionist preferred present revision.
